sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Style scanning and colour setup
sections.what: Lists the folders scanned for class names and adds a blue colour set named primary for use in class names.
sections.why: Likely reason: keeps the brand colour defined in one place.
sections.watch_out: The lib folder is not in the scan list, so class names used only in files there would be lost.

summary: Tells Tailwind CSS which files to scan for class names, and defines a blue colour set named primary.
purpose: Controls which styles end up in the final CSS and gives the app a named colour set.
why: Likely reason: scanning only the listed folders keeps the final CSS small.
how: Lists the folders to scan for class names, then adds the primary colour shades. No extra plugins are added.
inputs: Files in the pages, components, and app folders.
outputs: A Tailwind setup used during the build.
risks: Class names used only in files outside the scanned folders are dropped from the final CSS.
debug: If a style works in development but not in a built version, check that the file's folder is in the scan list.
